schedulerSpotlight.title: SchedulerPro

schedulerpro.title: SchedulerPro
schedulerpro.shortDescription: Multi-tenant SaaS for scheduling, calendar and operations dashboard.

The product includes authentication, company management, dashboard metrics, calendar views and full appointment workflows, with automated tests (Vitest).
features: Automated tests (Vitest / Supertest in product repo)
